name: Learn Voraciously
definition: We are hungry for the best ideas and seek them from all sources. We embrace growing pains. Ego is the enemy: we avoid rationalizing mistakes and are vocally self-critical.

rows.situation: When you were wrong in public
rows.under: Explains the context until the mistake dissolves.
rows.justRight: Says you were wrong, says what you now believe, and says what changes.
rows.over: Performs self-criticism so often that people stop trusting your judgment at all.

rows.situation: When someone else has already solved this
rows.under: Builds your own version without looking.
rows.justRight: Goes and reads how they did it, takes what transfers, and says where it came from.
rows.over: Copies a solution built for conditions you do not have.

rows.situation: When the new job is uncomfortable
rows.under: Retreats to the part of the job you were already good at.
rows.justRight: Stays in the uncomfortable part long enough to become competent at it.
rows.over: Chases discomfort for its own sake and never gets good at anything.

rows.under: Stops reading. Your knowledge goes a year out of date and you do not notice.
rows.justRight: Keeps a source of new input outside your own team, and lets it change your mind.
rows.over: Rethinks settled fundamentals so often that the team cannot build on anything.

rows.under: Explains why the person misread the situation.
rows.justRight: Assumes there is something true in it, finds that part, and acts on it.
rows.over: Takes every piece of feedback as an instruction, and loses your own judgment.

rows.under: Assigns blame and closes the file.
rows.justRight: Writes down what was believed, what was true, and what would have shown the difference earlier.
rows.over: Turns every event into a learning exercise until the team dreads shipping.
